newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM says ruling LDP won't request rate rise.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM says ruling LDP won't request rate rise.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto told a parliamentary committee on Wednesday it is not proper for politicians to make comments on interest rates, which are a matter for the Bank of Japan (BOJ).
"The ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) does not intend to make any request to the Bank of Japan to raise interest rates," he said.
He also said he had not received any request from LDP politicians to ask the BOJ to raise interest rates.
